title: Kirkkan
overview: The death of a village girl in central Kerala sparks suspicion when she is found hanging in a rubber plantation. Led by ASI Kuku, the investigation and interrogations uncover secrets, lies, and a truth far more disturbing than expected.

songs.title: Kaalame
songs.singers: Mridula Warrier, Mohammed Maqbool Mansoor, Jyothish Kassi
